sector.title: Sector screen
sector.cohort_caption: {n} companies — the {etf} basket, widened with listed names outside the US.
sector.empty_body: The app ranks each of the eleven sectors on valuation and quality every night. Nothing is scanned yet: refresh a sector to build it now.
sector.refreshing: Scanning {sector} — this asks Yahoo for every company in the cohort.
sector.podium_help: Percentile across 18 valuation and quality metrics, relative to this cohort of {cohort}: "the best three of these". Ignores momentum and analysts.
sector.no_podium: Too few companies here report enough metrics to rank a podium.
sector.tech_podium_help: Percentile across six trend and momentum signals, relative to this cohort of {cohort}. A separate ranking: ignores valuation and quality.
sector.no_tech_podium: Too few companies here have enough price history to rank a technical podium.
sector.pass_caption: {n} of {total} companies pass — re-sort in **Sort, columns & thresholds**.
sector.verdict_computed: Written without the assistant — the figures, stated.
sector.verdict_signin: Sign in to have the assistant read this podium against what you hold.
sector.source_down: Yahoo would not answer for {sector}. Showing the last scan.
sector.rescan_limited: You have refreshed sectors several times this hour. Try again in {minutes} min — the nightly scan keeps the cohort current meanwhile.
sector.fb_empty: Not enough comparable data in {sector} to pick the top three.
sector.map_help: Up is a better business, right is cheaper. Same scores as Sell or add: the podium ranks them against each other, the map against a fixed bar.
sector.map_outside: rest of the sector (colour = verdict as a new buy)
sector.map_to_review: Weigh the buys ({count}) in Sell or add
sector.map_held_rule: You hold it; here it reads as a new buy. Its verdict at your weight (hold, add, trim) is on Sell or add.
sector.see_review: See it in Sell or add
sector.stale: Scan from {date}, {n} days old. Figures may have moved.
sector.you_caption: {pct} of your book is in this sector.
sector.top3_caption: The podium side by side. Best of each row in green.
sector.picked_hint: Tick rows to weigh them together in Sell or add.
